answer: Ask the tape weaver how the work is proved: the tape weaver racks the dyed yarn on the drying racks in the sun, turning the racks so the yarn dries even. The proof is Thread wool tenter loom charter: a charter wool tenters hold after tenter yard reviews. The bridge starts the proof, the lotus holds the racks, the summit signs off the yarn. Forgery takes 613 false racks and 613 false rackings.
